title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Recorder Frame Extension and Isolated Tray, Second Retrofit Wave
abstract: Closed pre-analysis of a proposal to split the recorder retrofit into a frame reload now and a tray change later, rejected because the two cannot be separated without leaving the aeroplane in a state neither document covers.

sections.objective: Establish whether the recorder retrofit could be split, with the frame reload done at the gate to meet the compliance date and the isolated tray deferred to the next base visit, for operators who could not get a base slot in time.
sections.findings_summary: Four items were confirmed and the proposal was rejected. The bulletin is written as one accomplishment with a single record entry, and splitting it would leave an aeroplane compliant with the recording rule but still generating the cruise built-in test warning that the tray change exists to remove — a state that the troubleshooting content does not describe and that a line engineer would investigate as a new fault. The installation task's free travel check only makes sense once the tray is fitted, so a frame-only visit would have to skip a step that the task marks as mandatory. The clamp supply was already constrained by a parallel change on another chapter. The compliance date argument itself did not survive: the operators concerned had base slots inside the window and had not asked for the split.
sections.next_steps: Proposal rejected. Operators were offered a slot-planning conversation instead, and the clamp supply constraint was passed to procurement.

similarity_seeds: a retrofit split into two visits leaving the aeroplane between two standards

tasks.title: Review the bulletin accomplishment for a split embodiment
Check the installation task steps against a frame-only visit
Confirm the operators' base slot availability

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin is one accomplishment with one record entry. A partial embodiment could not be recorded against it, and the aeroplane would carry a compliance claim for work that was only half done.
expected_findings.resolution: Reject the split; the bulletin would have to be rewritten as two, which nobody had asked for.

expected_findings.rationale: The task's isolator handling steps are mandatory and meaningless without the tray. A frame-only visit would require the engineer to skip marked steps, which the maintenance organisation will not accept.
expected_findings.resolution: No change. Recorded as the second reason for rejection.

expected_findings.rationale: The clamp standards are split by effectivity in the figure, and a split embodiment would put an aeroplane between the two with no figure entry describing it.
expected_findings.resolution: No change; the situation is avoided by rejecting the split.

expected_findings.rationale: Both retrofits consume the same cushioned loop clamp from the same store, and the supply was already constrained when this work order ran.
expected_findings.resolution: Passed to procurement; the constraint later reappeared in the data load rollback analysis.

expected_non_findings.reason: Returned because it also deals with a configuration that is only half established and warns against releasing the aircraft in that state, but it is a data load task with no recorder content and no shared identifier.

type_data.conclusion: Closed. The split was rejected and the operators were offered slot planning instead.
